review_source: Independent Claude falsification review supplied by user

accepted_findings_and_actions.finding: Runtime provider/model identity cannot rely on response metadata
accepted_findings_and_actions.action: Added out-of-band runtime identity attestation bound to provider/model/SKU/deployment_path/qualification lineage; provider self-attestation is rejected; response model label is diagnostic only; router revalidates qualification and attestation after the remote call.
Added external task-policy required-invariant catalog and fail-closed contract completeness validation; model-visible contract cannot define its own required catalog.

Added initial composite attack suite combining qualification drift, duplicate retry, capability revocation, artifact drift, policy drift, and qualification revocation, plus a valid-composition control.

accepted_findings_and_actions.finding: Reviewer independence may share the same foundation model through different paths
accepted_findings_and_actions.action: Reviewer independence now requires foundation_lineage diversity; same foundation via different providers/routes is correlated and cannot count as independent.

accepted_findings_and_actions.finding: Truncated reviewer output can appear complete
accepted_findings_and_actions.action: OpenAI-compatible evidence now requires terminal finish_reason=stop; length-truncated or missing-terminal completions are rejected even if syntactically valid.

Performance eligibility now requires pre-registered minimum sample count and difficulty-band coverage in addition to independent adjudication, role/task/risk scope, epoch, and false-positive threshold.
Fixed policy binding so authority artifact hash must match both current artifact and request artifact; stale requests cannot preserve authority after current artifact mutation.
Provider router re-reads qualification and identity attestation after the remote call and discards the result if authority changed while execution was in flight.
Added matched clean controls for legitimate current-SHA transition, cleared gate, single event consumption, and authorized COMPLETE.

failure_and_repair_record.reason: Clean-control test expected orchestrator:unique-event while governor canonical event key is orchestrator::unique-event.

open_boundaries: Hash-linked evidence is tamper-evident but not externally immutable against privileged rewrite from genesis; production requires independent/WORM anchoring or notarization.
SQLite concurrency proof does not establish multi-node consensus, partition tolerance, leader failover, or distributed durability semantics.

Out-of-band identity attestation is now a required control contract, but production must obtain trustworthy independently verified or cryptographic provider/deployment identity evidence rather than fabricate attestations.
Composite attack coverage is an initial explicit suite, not exhaustive pairwise/triple, property-based, mutation, or fuzz testing.
Additional generalized fixture-contamination cases remain useful to test that EXP-C C001 lessons generalize beyond the original fixture.
No result in this adjudication authorizes merging PR #1 or production release.
scientific_interpretation: The external falsification review identified multiple real weaknesses, including one concrete artifact-binding code defect. Those accepted harness-level findings were remediated and the exact repaired head passed the expanded suite. The appropriate claim is therefore a harness-level pass after external-review remediation, not production correctness. External evidence anchoring, distributed datastore correctness, and deeper compositional/fuzz validation remain separate obligations.
